newsitem.title: FRANCE: Union Miniere cuts French zinc price.
newsitem.headline: Union Miniere cuts French zinc price.

text.p: Union Miniere SA subsidiary Union Miniere France said on Friday it had cut its indicative zinc price to 10,770 francs per tonne.
The cut follows a dive in international zinc prices from seven-year highs which had prompted a series of price increases by Union Miniere and others in the past week.
Union Miniere said in a statement the new price, which compares with a previous level of 11,980 francs, would take effect immediately.
